core_obligations: Identify R(T) and verify the equivalence-relation axioms (proof lines 1410-1412).
Read etaleness of the projections off the etale morphism U -> F (proof lines 1413-1414).
Prove U -> F is a surjection of sheaves via the covering V = T x_{xi,F,f} U (proof lines 1417-1424).
Conclude that the diagram is a coequalizer (proof lines 1424-1426).
difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: for an algebraic space F over S and a surjective etale morphism f : U -> F from a scheme, with R = U x_F U, the map j : R -> U x_S U defines an equivalence relation, its two projections are etale, and the diagram R => U -> F is a coequalizer in the category of fppf sheaves (source lines 1387-1407). The proof identifies R(T) with the pairs of U(T) with equal image under f, reads etaleness off f, and then verifies that U -> F is a surjection of sheaves by pulling back an arbitrary section along the covering V = T x_{xi,F,f} U, after which the coequalizer statement follows from surjectivity.
